answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit that grows with the number of identities it controls, so creating a hundred sock puppets costs a hundred stakes. A public reputation signal, built from attested work rather than self-claims, then gates access to paid tasks: newcomers start at the bottom and climb only through verified contributions. As the stake curve steepens toward its zenith, the cost of a Sybil spiral — spinning up fresh identities after each ban — exceeds any gain from faking volume, because every new identity must re-earn trust from zero while its stake stays locked.
